events.verdict: Booker (PHX) establishes himself in Walter's (TOR) path prior to the contact.
Booker (PHX) goes to, not through, Walter (TOR) and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the drive. Booker inadvertently dribbles the ball off his own foot to lose control of it.
Barnes' (TOR) left forearm slightly extends as he releases back toward the long rebound, and the contact with Booker (PHX) is marginal.
Booker (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Barrett's (TOR) path as he defends the drive and shot attempt.
Highsmith (PHX) and Barrett (TOR) mutually engage during the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Ingram (TOR) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Booker's (PHX) shot attempt goes directly out of bounds and possession is correctly awarded to Toronto.
O'Neale (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Ingram (TOR) during the drive.
O'Neale (PHX) legally contests Ingram's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Barnes (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Booker (PHX) during the drive.

Replay review of the foul called on Barnes (TOR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Barnes moves laterally into Booker (PHX), initiating body-to-body contact that affects his SQBR. The illegal contact occurs prior to the gather; therefore, after review, a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
Goodwin (PHX) establishes himself in Walter's (TOR) path prior to the contact.

Barnes' (TOR) arm makes contact with the ball that dislodges it during Green's (PHX) dunk attempt. The ensuing follow-through contact, after the ball has already been dislodged, is considered incidental.
Booker (PHX) makes contact with the ball during Barrett's (TOR) dunk attempt.
Goodwin (PHX) and Barnes (TOR) mutually engage and move together toward the baseline, where marginal body to body contact occurs between Barnes and Green (PHX).
Walter (TOR) legally contests Green's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Goodwin (PHX) grasps Barnes' (TOR) arm as Barnes secures the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Allen (PHX) initiates contact with Barnes' (TOR) arm and the contact affects his SQBR.
Goodwin (PHX) grasps and immediately releases Barrett's (TOR) jersey as he disengages from the screen.
Barrett (TOR) makes contact with Booker's (PHX) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Goodwin (PHX) commits a take foul on Walter (TOR).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Barnes (TOR) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to Phoenix.
Walter (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Booker (PHX) during the drive.
